about: [O1] The streaming test (brief O1 §3): two loops of the drive-through by real keys (over ten minutes), the JS heap (after a collection) and the renderer's geometries and textures read at the start, after the first loop and after the second - flat (no leak: geometries, textures, listeners), the chunks built and dropped. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o1_stream.json

steps.eval: (window.__mem = [{ at: 'start', ...N.renderer.info.memory, chunks: G.city.stream.stats.live, programs: N.renderer.info.programs.length }], window.__mem[0])

steps.check: D.end === 'done' && D.inWall === 0 && D.districts.length >= 5 && D.lateN === 0 && D.missingSamples === 0 && D.over50 <= 2
steps.label: loop 1 (the drive-through): every district, nothing driven through, no chunk missing or late, no hitch

steps.eval: (window.__mem.push({ at: 'loop1', ...N.renderer.info.memory, chunks: G.city.stream.stats.live, built: G.city.stream.stats.built, dropped: G.city.stream.stats.dropped, programs: N.renderer.info.programs.length }), window.__mem.at(-1))

(window.__mem.push({ at: 'loop2', ...N.renderer.info.memory, chunks: G.city.stream.stats.live, built: G.city.stream.stats.built, dropped: G.city.stream.stats.dropped, programs: N.renderer.info.programs.length }), window.__mem.at(-1))

steps.expect: window.__heap.loop2 <= window.__heap.loop1 * 1.08 + 4 && window.__mem[2].geometries <= window.__mem[1].geometries + 20 && window.__mem[2].textures <= window.__mem[1].textures + 2
steps.label: memory flat from the first loop to the second
